name: Question 6
problem: Find all of the subsets of $T={-1,0,1}.$
worked_solution:
To find every subset of $T,$ we list out every combination of elements within $T.$ 

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/linear/14038640/assets/03bdaa1b1033d662675e8b594fbc6ed2376b43dd71e28af7a8bf61d1ff17a012.png)

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

$$
∅,{-1},{0},{1},{-1,0},{-1,1},{0,1},{-1,0,1}.
$$

Question 6
?

Find all of the subsets of T={−1,0,1}.

a
∅,{−1},{0},{1},{−1,0},{−1,1},{0,1},{−1,0,1}
b
∅,{−1,0,1}
c
{−1},{0},{1}
d
∅,{−1},{0},{1}
e
{−1,0,1}
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

To find every subset of T, we list out every combination of elements within T.

We can use the following diagram to visualize the process:

Note that we must include the empty set since it is a subset of every set.

By doing this, we get

∅,{−1},{0},{1},{−1,0},{−1,1},{0,1},{−1,0,1}.
